GBIF API responses from api.gbif.org, recorded once on 2026-10-19 with the Pinakes user agent
(`pinakes/0.1.0 (+https://pubky.app; info@synonym.to)`), about one request every 1.5 seconds.
Parser regression fixtures for `pinakes_core::sources::gbif`; test runs make no requests.

`provenance.json` lists each fixture's request URL, status, content type, recording time, and the
size and SHA-256 of the body as served. Bodies over 64 KB are stored gzip-compressed (`.gz`).
The licence is per record: the occurrences are CC BY-NC 4.0 (5938027305) and CC BY 4.0
(4993788366), both iNaturalist observations; the species records are from the GBIF Backbone
Taxonomy (CC BY 4.0).
